note: The renderer registry tinylens proposes for tm://<host>/renderers/: one entry per media type, a module by address with its sha256, the manifest it was built against, and its fallback. module is relative to this file until a host gives it an address.

renderers.name: pattern
renderers.what: a pattern's numbers across every routine it was found in

renderers.name: game
renderers.what: a game's patterns, most first, and the lessons measured beside it

renderers.name: lesson
renderers.what: a lesson's numbers beside the game's, and its frames

renderers.name: blocks
renderers.what: any thing, as the blocks the server composes of it
